# Keys

Every key is resolved by one pure function over an enumerated state machine (TUI-DESIGN §3), never by handler order. Contexts in precedence order: minsize · overlay · picker · composer · global. Rebind through `${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/jevcode/keybindings.json` (`--keybindings <file>`, `JEVCODE_KEYBINDINGS`): `{ "namespace:action": "ctrl+g" | ["?", "f1"] | "ctrl+x ctrl+s" | "none" }` — a value with two space-separated keys is a chord completed within 3 s; `"none"`/`null` unbinds; reserved keys and unknown ids are refused with a `jevcode.log` warning, never fatally; `/help reload` re-reads the file.

Reserved and never rebindable (A24): `Ctrl+C`, `Ctrl+D`, `Ctrl+M`, `Ctrl+[`, `Ctrl+I` (Enter, Esc and Tab are the same bytes).

## Global

| Action id | Default keys | Does | When | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `global:exit` | `Ctrl+C` | idle: press twice within 1.5 s to exit; live: abort the run (with a draft: clear it) |  | reserved — never rebindable; F5 matrix (§3.3) |
| `global:exitOrDelete` | `Ctrl+D` | empty draft: press twice within 800 ms to exit (live: choose abort-and-exit or stay); with text: delete forward |  | reserved — never rebindable; F5 matrix (§3.3) |
| `global:escape` | `Esc` | idle: Esc Esc opens the rewind/steer menu; text: Esc Esc clears the draft; live: pause, Esc Esc aborts; review: decline |  | reserved — never rebindable; F5 matrix (§3.3); 30 ms re-buffer for Alt chords |
| `global:help` | `?`, `F1` | append the help block to the transcript | `?` on an empty draft |  |
| `global:detail` | `Ctrl+O` | append the last step's decision details and recent warnings; acknowledges !n |  |  |
| `global:repaint` | `Ctrl+L` | repaint the dynamic region (erase-lines + rewrite, never a clear) |  |  |
| `global:suspend` | `Ctrl+Z` | suspend to the shell (fg resumes and repaints) |  |  |
| `global:paneNext` | `]` | next pane tab (d → p → t → s) | empty draft |  |
| `global:panePrev` | `[` | previous pane tab | empty draft |  |
| `session:export` | _unbound_ | export the session transcript (= /export) |  | unbound by default; e.g. "session:export": "ctrl+x ctrl+s" |

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `review:approve` | `Y` | approve the proposed action once |  | reserved — never rebindable; the only key that ever approves (§6.2 invariant: never rebindable, and no other action may take y in the review box); armed one frame after the box is drawn (§6.3) |
| `review:decline` | `N` | decline |  | Esc declines too |
| `review:declineNote` | `D` | decline with a note (the composer row becomes the note field) |  |  |
| `review:expand` | `E` | expand / collapse the preview |  |  |
| `review:why` | `W` | then 1–5 within 1.5 s: append the /why block for that dimension (5 = matches_intent) |  |  |
| `review:abortRun` | `Ctrl+C` | empty draft: abort the run (the rejected confirm() is the decline); with a draft: clear the draft, the box stays |  | reserved — never rebindable |

## Ctrl-C / Esc / Ctrl-D

Windows: Ctrl-C ×2 within 1.5 s, Esc Esc within 2 s, Ctrl-D ×2 within 800 ms, Esc re-buffer 30 ms (a letter inside it is the Alt chord). The draft rule outranks the review rule: Ctrl-C with text clears the draft (to history, secrets masked) wherever you are; Ctrl-C with an empty draft aborts a live run (session mode stays, one-shot exits 130) or, under a pending review, aborts the run without committing a decline; Ctrl-C ×2 idle exits 0. Esc pauses a live run at the next step boundary, Esc Esc aborts; on an idle empty composer Esc Esc opens the rewind/steer menu. Ctrl-D with text deletes forward; on an empty composer Ctrl-D ×2 exits 0 (with a live run it asks `a run is live: [y] abort and exit   [n] stay`). See TUI-DESIGN §3.3 for the full matrix.
